name: @agentrica/mcp
description: Agentrica's AI agents, organized in departments, as a local MCP server (stdio): one prompt per agent, four read-only tools (including the departments' library and the format check of plan/ and audit/), three tools that send only after confirmation (agent ratings, token totals, project submissions) and, with the local panel, tools to ask the user and save agent reports.
author: Giulio Simone Floresta

scripts.prepack: rm -rf dist agents learn starter .claude LICENSE && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp -R src/page dist/mcp/src/page && cp -R ../../agents agents && cp -R ../../learn learn && cp -R ../../starter starter && mkdir .claude && cp -R ../../.claude/agents .claude/agents && cp ../../LICENSE LICENSE
